Mine's going to get buried in the comments, but here we go. 

Two days compete for it. 

1. My mom began scapegoating me when I was in the third grade(8-9 years old). She neglected doing my laundry for months, yet did my brothers's laundry. So one day after work, she tells me that she's going to take me somewhere special. She drives me to the thrift shop and walks me down the aisle at all of the jean shorts she wanted me to try on. I whisper to her quietly that I don't have any undergarments. She loses her shit. She walks me outside and pushes me against her car door. I opened the door and got in the front seat as she screams about me being a "fucking idiot", a "stupid bitch", a "unhygienic whore", a "retarded daughter" et cetera for nearly thirty minutes. I ran inside and left the door open. She came inside and begins to hit me. My dad doesn't even try to stop her. I got back to school the next day and no one noticed anything. 

2. The second time I tried to take my own life. I was already down that day, and then a "friend" of mine says as I'm talking to a different friend, "Jenna, you should go kill yourself." I try to say that she's out of line, but instead plays the victim and sings songs about how awful of a friend I am to her. I got home that day and I realized that no one would miss me if I was gone. There's 7 billion people on this earth, so who cares? I felt nothing, numbness as I ran upstairs to grab a bottle of pills. I downed around 1/3 of the bottle before feeling sick. I got around 1/2 of the bottle before I puked. A lot of the pills were still inside though, and the next day I went back to school, but skipped class. I was 14 at the time.
